person: GLYNNIS MARGARET LERENA (born BOLTON) versus ANTON ARMANDO LERENA - divorce
what_it_would_answer: *** WHO ANTON ARMANDO IS. *** He is the one man this archive cannot place: an estate advertised 2013 for a death in 2003, a 1977 debt case, and no parents anywhere. A divorce summons states the DATE AND PLACE OF MARRIAGE and usually the parties' ages; the order deals with the children. Between them they should fix his generation. *** Now the best file on the list, because the two estates fell away. ***
pages_that_matter: The SUMMONS (particulars of claim) and the FINAL ORDER. Not the pleadings, not the discovery.

person: Opposed applications, ANNE MARGARET LERENA versus RICARDO PAUL LERENA
what_it_would_answer: *** DO NOT ORDER. *** Both are interlocutory applications inside the SAME divorce as rank 2. Ordering them is paying three times for one dispute. Order them only if 1248/1979 turns out to be missing.

*** NAAIRS gives NO VOLUME NUMBER for any of the four court references *** - only a case number and a year. Estate files retrieve cleanly on MHG number; court files may need a volume traced at the depot. *** Tell her this before she goes. *** She would rather be told not to hunt than lose an hour, and if a volume is not obvious in ten minutes the file should be abandoned in favour of the estate files.
